title: 1. 三日 あとです
english_summary: Takashi realizes his mother's birthday is only three days away — and he has almost no money. Hana declares it a plan just between the two of them.
content:
朝ごはんの まえ、たかしは 新聞を 見ました。
新聞の 日を 見ました。
たかし：あ！
日よう日は お母さんの たんじょうびです。
三日 あとです。
でも、たかしは 何も ありません。
学校で、たかしは はなに 話しました。
たかし：日よう日は 母の たんじょうびです。
はな：えっ、いいですね！何を しますか？
たかし：わかりません…お金も 少ないです。
はな：うーん…
はな：じゃあ、これは 二人だけです！
たかし：二人だけ…？
はな：そうです。お母さんは 何も 聞きません。
はな：日よう日に、みんなで 「おめでとう」を 言います。
たかし：いいですね！でも、何を しますか？
はな：あしたも 話しましょう。
その 夜、お母さんは たかしに 聞きました。
おかあさん：今日、学校は どうでしたか？
たかし：え？な、何も ありません！
おかあさん：…そうですか。
でも、お母さんは たかしを ちょっと 見ました。
english_content:
Before breakfast, Takashi looked at the newspaper.
He looked at the date on the newspaper.
Takashi: Ah!
Sunday is his mother's birthday.
It's three days away.
But Takashi has nothing.
At school, Takashi told Hana.
Takashi: Sunday is my mom's birthday.
Hana: Oh, how nice! What will you do?
Takashi: I don't know… and I have very little money.
Hana: Hmm…
Hana: Then this is just between the two of us!
Takashi: Just… the two of us?
Hana: Yes. Your mom must hear nothing.
Hana: On Sunday, we all say "congratulations".
Takashi: Sounds great! But what will we do?
Hana: Let's talk more tomorrow.
That night, his mother asked Takashi:
Mother: How was school today?
Takashi: Huh? N-nothing at all!
Mother: …I see.
But his mother gave Takashi a little look.

title: 2. 小さい お金の 買いもの
english_summary: At the shop everything nice is too expensive for Takashi's little money — until he realizes the best present might not be something you can buy.
content:
つぎの 日、二人は 店へ 行きました。
はな：この 店は 何でも ありますよ。
たかしは きれいな ぼうしを 見ました。
たかし：あ、母は ぼうしが すきです。
でも、ぼうしは とても 高いです。
たかし：高い…買いません。
はなは 小さい とけいを 見ました。
はな：これは どうですか？
たかし：それも 高いです。
二人は 店の 中を 歩きました。
安い ものは、いい ものでは ありません。
いい ものは、高いです。
たかし：私の お金は 少ないです…
はな：うーん、そうですね。
その あとで、たかしは 花の 店を 見ました。
小さくて 赤い 花が ありました。
花は 安いです。
たかし：花と…それから、手紙は どうですか？
たかし：手紙は、お金では 買いません。
はな：いいですね！えも かきましょう！
たかしは 花を 買いました。
お金が ちょっと あります。
はな：その お金で、おかしも 買いましょう。
english_content:
The next day, the two went to a shop.
Hana: This shop has everything.
Takashi looked at a pretty hat.
Takashi: Ah, my mom likes hats.
But the hat is very expensive.
Takashi: Too expensive… I won't buy it.
Hana looked at a small clock.
Hana: How about this?
Takashi: That's expensive too.
The two walked around the shop.
The cheap things are not nice things.
The nice things are expensive.
Takashi: My money is so little…
Hana: Hmm, that's true.
After that, Takashi saw a flower shop.
There were small red flowers.
The flowers are cheap.
Takashi: A flower and… how about a letter?
Takashi: A letter is something money can't buy.
Hana: Great! Let's draw a picture too!
Takashi bought a flower.
He has a little money left.
Hana: With that money, let's buy sweets too.

title: 3. おじいさんの しゃしん
english_summary: The old neighbor shows Takashi a photo of his mother as a little girl — in the park, on her birthday, long ago. Now Takashi knows exactly where the party should be.
content:
夜、たかしは おじいさんの 家へ 行きました。
たかし：こんばんは。ちょっと いいですか？
おじいさん：ああ、たかしさん。どうぞ、どうぞ。
たかし：日よう日は 母の たんじょうびです。
おじいさん：ほう、そうですか。
たかし：おじいさんは、子どもの 母を 見ましたか？
おじいさん：ええ、見ましたよ。この まちの 子どもでした。
おじいさんは 古い しゃしんを 出しました。
小さい 女の 子が こうえんに いました。
たかし：これは…母ですか？
おじいさん：そうです。たんじょうびの 日ですよ。
しゃしんの 中で、母は 花と いっしょでした。
とても たのしい 目でした。
おじいさん：お母さんは この こうえんが すきでした。
おじいさん：毎年、ここで たんじょうびを しました。
たかし：わかりました！
たかし：日よう日、こうえんで します！
おじいさん：いいですね。私も 行きますよ。
たかし：この しゃしん、ちょっと いいですか？
おじいさん：どうぞ、どうぞ。
たかしは しゃしんと いっしょに 家へ かえりました。
english_content:
In the evening, Takashi went to the old neighbor's house.
Takashi: Good evening. Do you have a moment?
Old man: Ah, Takashi. Come in, come in.
Takashi: Sunday is my mom's birthday.
Old man: Oh, is that so.
Takashi: Did you ever see my mom as a child?
Old man: Yes, I did. She was a child of this town.
The old man took out an old photograph.
A little girl was in the park.
Takashi: Is this… my mom?
Old man: Yes. On her birthday.
In the photo, his mother was together with flowers.
She had very happy eyes.
Old man: Your mother loved this park.
Old man: Every year, she had her birthday here.
Takashi: I've got it!
Takashi: On Sunday, we'll do it in the park!
Old man: Wonderful. I will come too.
Takashi: May I borrow this photo?
Old man: Please, please.
Takashi went home together with the photograph.

title: 4. 雨、雨、雨
english_summary: Sunday morning: rain. The park plan is ruined — or is it? While Hana takes Mother out under an umbrella, the boys turn the house into the park.
content:
日よう日の 朝でした。
たかしは まどを 見ました。
雨、雨、雨です。
たかし：あ…こうえんは…
でも、電話が ありました。
はな：たかしさん、だいじょうぶですよ！
たかし：えっ、どうしてですか？
はな：今日は、家の 中が こうえんです！
はな：私は お母さんと 外へ 行きます。
はな：おじいさんと、へやを きれいに して ください。
はなは たかしの 家へ 来ました。
はな：おかあさん、いっしょに 買いものへ 行きませんか？
おかあさん：雨ですよ？
はな：かさが ありますから、だいじょうぶです！
二人は 出ました。
それから、たかしと おじいさんは とても いそがしいです。
つくえの 上に 白い 紙。
紙の 上に、はなの えと たかしの 手紙。
花と おかしと おちゃ。
それから、おじいさんの 古い しゃしん。
おじいさん：いい こうえんですね。
たかし：あ！二人が かえりました！
english_content:
It was Sunday morning.
Takashi looked at the window.
Rain, rain, rain.
Takashi: Ah… the park is…
But then, there was a phone call.
Hana: Takashi, it's all right!
Takashi: Huh, why?
Hana: Today, the inside of the house is the park!
Hana: I will go out with your mom.
Hana: Please make the room beautiful with the old man.
Hana came to Takashi's house.
Hana: Ma'am, won't you go shopping with me?
Mother: But it's raining?
Hana: We have umbrellas, so it's fine!
The two went out.
After that, Takashi and the old man are very busy.
White paper on the table.
On the paper, Hana's drawing and Takashi's letter.
Flowers, sweets and tea.
And the old man's old photograph.
Old man: A fine park, isn't it.
Takashi: Ah! The two are coming back!

title: 5. 小さい こうえん
english_summary: Mother walks into a living room turned into the park of her childhood photo. The letter says what presents can't — and the rain outside doesn't matter at all.
content:
お母さんは 家に 入りました。
みんな：たんじょうび、おめでとうございます！
おかあさん：えっ！？
お母さんは つくえを 見ました。
花、おかし、え、手紙…
それから、あの 古い しゃしん。
おかあさん：この しゃしん…！
おじいさん：あの こうえんですよ。
おかあさん：私の こうえん…
たかし：雨ですから、こうえんは ここです。
たかし：小さい こうえんです。
お母さんは 手紙を 読みました。
「お母さん、いつも ありがとうございます。」
「お母さんの 子どもで、私は たのしいです。」
お母さんの 目に、雨が ありました。
おかあさん：…これは 雨では ありませんよ。
みんなは 「はは！」と 言いました。
それから、みんなで おかしを 食べました。
外は 雨でした。
でも、家の 中は はれでした。
おかあさん：一ばん いい たんじょうびです。
小さい お金の、大きい たんじょうびでした。
english_content:
Mother came into the house.
Everyone: Happy birthday!
Mother: What!?
Mother looked at the table.
Flowers, sweets, a drawing, a letter…
And that old photograph.
Mother: This photo…!
Old man: That park, you know.
Mother: My park…
Takashi: Because of the rain, the park is here.
Takashi: It's a small park.
Mother read the letter.
"Mom, thank you for everything, always."
"Being your child makes me happy."
In Mother's eyes, there was rain.
Mother: …This is not rain, you know.
Everyone said "Haha!"
Then everyone ate the sweets together.
Outside it was raining.
But inside the house, it was sunny.
Mother: This is the best birthday.
A little money — a big birthday.

title: 放学以后
english_summary: Two classmates make an after-school plan over text.
content:
小明：你好！你现在忙吗？
朋友：不忙，怎么了？
小明：放学以后，我们一起去公园吧。
朋友：好啊！我也想去。
小明：我们几点去？
朋友：四点，好吗？
小明：好，四点在学校门口见。
朋友：没问题，一会儿见！

title: 今天吃什么
english_summary: A quick chat about what to eat for dinner.
content:
妈妈：你今天想吃什么？
小明：我想吃面条。
妈妈：家里没有面条了。
小明：那我们吃米饭和鸡蛋，好吗？
妈妈：好。你饿了吗？
小明：有一点饿。
妈妈：那我现在做饭。
小明：谢谢妈妈！

title: 周末做什么
english_summary: Two friends compare weekend plans.
content:
朋友：这个周末你有空吗？
小明：有空。你想做什么？
朋友：我想去看电影。
小明：好主意！看什么电影？
朋友：一个新的中国电影，听说很好看。
小明：几点的？
朋友：星期六下午三点。
小明：太好了，我们一起去！

title: 下雨天
english_summary: A rainy-day walk in the park, told scene by scene.
content:
🌧️ 今天下雨了。
🌂 小明拿着雨伞。
🌳 他去公园走路。
🐦 树上有小鸟。
🌸 雨里的花很美。
😊 小明很开心。
english_content:
It is raining today.
Xiaoming is holding an umbrella.
He goes to walk in the park.
There are little birds in the tree.
The flowers in the rain are beautiful.
Xiaoming is very happy.

title: 我的早上
english_summary: One quiet morning, one scene at a time.
content:
☀️ 早上七点了。
🛏️ 小明起床了。
🪥 他刷牙洗脸。
🍞 他吃面包喝牛奶。
🎒 他拿书包上学。
🚌 他坐公共汽车。
english_content:
It is seven in the morning.
Xiaoming gets out of bed.
He brushes his teeth and washes his face.
He eats bread and drinks milk.
He takes his backpack to school.
He rides the bus.

title: 在动物园
english_summary: An afternoon at the zoo, animal by animal.
content:
🦁 这是一只狮子。
🐼 那是一只熊猫。
🐒 猴子在树上玩。
🐘 大象很大很高。
🍦 我们吃了冰淇淋。
📸 妈妈拍了照片。
english_content:
This is a lion.
That is a panda.
The monkey is playing in the tree.
The elephant is very big and tall.
We ate ice cream.
Mom took a photo.

title: 放学以后聊天
english_summary: Reply inside a chat: make an after-school plan with a friend.
content:
朋友：你今天去学校吗？
小明：去，我现在在学校。
朋友：放学以后你想做什么？
小明：我想去公园。
朋友：好啊，我们几点去？
小明：四点，在学校门口见。

1.pinyin: Wǒ bú qù, wǒ zài jiā.

title: 周末的电影
english_summary: Reply inside a chat: agree on a weekend movie.
content:
朋友：这个周末你有空吗？
小明：有空，你想做什么？
朋友：我想去看电影。
小明：好主意！看什么电影？
朋友：一个新的中国电影。
小明：太好了，几点的？

title: 回家的路
english_summary: After years in the city, Xiaochuan goes back to the village and finds the old bridge — and his parents — still waiting.
content:
小川在大城市工作了很久。
每天都很忙，压力也很大。
今天早上，他终于决定回家看看。
火车很慢，外边的世界很美丽。
到了村里，阳光正好。
他看见了那个旧桥。
桥还在，一点儿也没有变化。
父母正在桥上等他。
妈妈：小川，你回来了！
母亲突然笑了，眼前都是光。
小川心里想，这就是幸福。
有些东西，很久也不会消失。
english_content:
Xiaochuan had worked in the big city for a long time.
Every day was busy, and the pressure was heavy.
This morning, he finally decided to go home for a visit.
The train was slow, and the world outside was beautiful.
When he reached the village, the sunlight was just right.
He saw that old bridge.
The bridge was still there — not changed at all.
His parents were waiting for him on the bridge.
Mum: Xiaochuan, you are back!
His mother suddenly smiled, and everything before his eyes was light.
Xiaochuan thought to himself: this is happiness.
Some things do not disappear, even after a long time.

title: 新的决定
english_summary: Xiaochuan tells Lin Yuqing he wants to move back to the village. She hears him out — and backs him.
content:
小川：雨晴，我有一个决定。
林雨晴：什么决定？
小川：我想回村里工作。
林雨晴：真的吗？你不喜欢城市了？
小川：城市很好，但是我需要家人。
林雨晴：我理解你。
小川：我有点儿紧张。
林雨晴：这是你的人生，我支持你。
林雨晴：什么时候走？
小川：下个月。
林雨晴：那我们要好好庆祝一下！

title: 坚持
english_summary: Xiaohua runs her school race. She does not win — and finds that finishing was the point.
content:
小花是学校比赛的选手。
昨天的训练很困难。
她的教练说，慢慢来。
今天早上，比赛开始了。
前面的路还很长。
她很紧张，也有点儿害怕。
但是她没有停止。
教练的建议在她心里。
她终于到达了。
她不是第一，但是她很高兴。
坚持就是胜利。
english_content:
Xiaohua is a competitor in her school race.
Yesterday's training was hard.
Her coach said: take it slowly.
This morning, the race began.
The road ahead was still long.
She was nervous, and a little afraid too.
But she did not stop.
Her coach's advice stayed in her heart.
At last, she reached the end.
She was not first, but she was very happy.
To keep going is itself a victory.

title: 1. 最大的是谁
english_summary: Mouse Father wants the greatest husband in the world for his daughter. She already likes someone — but he is not listening. He looks up, sees the sun, and decides.
content:
老鼠爸爸有一个女儿。
女儿已经不小了。
爸爸：我要给女儿找一个最好的丈夫。
爸爸：这个丈夫要是最大的。
女儿：爸爸，我已经喜欢一个人了。
爸爸：你别说话，我知道怎么做。
早上，爸爸走出门口。
他看见了天。
爸爸：天在最上面，天最大！
爸爸：我去问天。
english_content:
Mouse Father had a daughter.
His daughter was not little any more.
Father: I will find my daughter the very best husband.
Father: And that husband must be the greatest of all.
Daughter: Dad, there is already someone I like.
Father: Don’t talk, I know what I am doing.
In the morning, Father walked out of the door.
He saw the sun.
Father: The sun is highest of all — the sun is the greatest!
Father: I will go and ask the sun.

title: 2. 天说的话
english_summary: After a long walk Father reaches the sun and asks his question. The sun gives an answer he did not expect: something can blot him out completely.
content:
爸爸走了很长时间，走了很远的路。
爸爸：天，您最大吗？
天：不，我不是最大的。
天：云彩来了，大家就看不见我。
天：云彩比我大。
爸爸：那我去问云彩。
天：云彩就在那边。
爸爸看了看上面。
上面有很多云彩。
爸爸：云彩，请等一等我！
english_content:
Father walked a long time, down a very long road.
Father: Sun, are you the greatest?
Sun: No, I am not the greatest.
Sun: When the white clouds come, nobody can see me at all.
Sun: The white clouds are greater than I am.
Father: Then I will go and ask the clouds.
Sun: The clouds are right over there.
Father looked up.
Above him there were many white clouds.
Father: Clouds, please wait for me!

title: 3. 云彩走了
english_summary: The clouds admit they are not the greatest either. Something moves them whether they want to go or not — and Father starts to wonder if this will ever end.
content:
云彩：谁在叫我？
爸爸：云彩，您最大吗？
云彩：不是我。
云彩：风来的时候，我就走了。
云彩：我不想走，但是我不能不走。
爸爸：风？风在哪儿？
云彩：您听。
这个时候，爸爸听见了一个很大的东西。
那个东西很快，也很大。
爸爸：这就是风吗？
english_content:
Clouds: Who is calling us?
Father: Clouds, are you the greatest?
Clouds: Not us.
Clouds: When the wind comes, we go.
Clouds: We do not want to go, but we cannot stay.
Father: The wind? Where is the wind?
Clouds: Listen.
Just then, Father heard something very big.
It was fast, and it was large.
Father: So this is the wind?

title: 4. 风过不去的东西
english_summary: The wind is proud: it can go anywhere in the world. Anywhere except one place. Father is running out of things bigger than the last.
content:
风：对，我就是风。
爸爸：风，您最大吗？
风：我很快，我哪儿都能去。
风：早上在这里，晚上就在很远的路上。
爸爸：那您最大了！
风：不。有一个东西，我过不去。
爸爸：什么东西？
风：墙壁。
风：我到了墙壁那里，就要回来。
爸爸看了看前面的墙壁，走了过去。
english_content:
Wind: Yes, I am the wind.
Father: Wind, are you the greatest?
Wind: I am fast. I can go anywhere.
Wind: In the morning I am here; by evening I am far down the road.
Father: Then you are the greatest!
Wind: No. There is one thing I cannot get past.
Father: What thing?
Wind: A wall.
Wind: When I reach a wall, I have to turn back.
Father looked at the wall ahead and walked over to it.

title: 5. 最大的就在家里
english_summary: The wall gives Father the last answer, and it is not the one he was looking for. He walks home and finds that his daughter was right on the very first morning.
content:
爸爸：墙壁，您最大吗？
墙壁：别问我了。
墙壁：老鼠住在我里面。
墙壁：我快要坏了。
爸爸：老鼠？
墙壁：对。我最不喜欢老鼠。
爸爸没有说话。
他走了很远的路，现在他要回家。
爸爸回到家的时候，天已经晚了。
女儿正在门口和一只老鼠说话。
爸爸：他是谁？
女儿：他就是我喜欢的人。
爸爸看了看他，笑了。
爸爸：我走了这么远的路。
爸爸：最大的，就在家里。
english_content:
Father: Wall, are you the greatest?
Wall: Don’t ask me.
Wall: Mice live inside me.
Wall: I am close to falling apart.
Father: Mice?
Wall: Yes. Mice are the one thing I cannot stand.
Father said nothing.
He had walked a very long road, and now he wanted to go home.
By the time Father got home, it was already late.
His daughter was at the door, talking with a mouse.
Father: Who is he?
Daughter: He is the one I like.
Father looked at him, and laughed.
Father: I walked such a long road.
Father: And the greatest of all was at home the whole time.

title: 1. 一只跑得很快的兔子
english_summary: A farmer works his field every day and is tired of it. Then a rabbit runs straight into the tree at the edge of the field, and that evening he eats meat for the first time in a long while.
content:
一个农民每天早上去田里工作。
他从早上工作到晚上。
每天都是这样，他很累。
农民：什么时候我可以不工作呢？
田的旁边有一个大树。
这天中午，一只兔子跑过来。
兔子跑得非常快。
它没有看见那个树。
兔子到了树那里，就不动了。
农民走过去，拿了兔子。
农民：今天我不买肉了！
那天晚上，他吃得很好。
english_content:
A farmer went out to his field every morning to work.
He worked from morning until night.
Every day was the same, and he was tired.
Farmer: When will I ever get to stop working?
Beside the field stood a big tree.
That noon, a rabbit came running.
The rabbit was running very fast.
It did not see the tree.
The rabbit reached the tree, and then it did not move again.
The farmer walked over and picked the rabbit up.
Farmer: Today I don’t have to buy meat!
That evening he ate very well.

title: 2. 第二天
english_summary: The next morning the farmer does not pick up his tools. He sits down beside the tree instead, and waits — certain that what happened once will happen again.
content:
第二天早上，农民没有去田里工作。
他走到那个树旁边，坐了下来。
农民：昨天有一只兔子。
农民：今天也会有的。
他坐着，看着前面的路。
上午过去了。
中午过去了。
没有兔子。
一个朋友从路上走过来。
朋友：你在这里做什么？你的田呢？
农民：我在等兔子。
朋友看了看他，什么也没有说。
english_content:
The next morning, the farmer did not go to work in his field.
He walked over to the tree and sat down.
Farmer: Yesterday there was a rabbit.
Farmer: There will be one today too.
He sat there, watching the road ahead.
The morning went by.
Noon went by.
No rabbit.
A friend came walking along the road.
Friend: What are you doing here? What about your field?
Farmer: I am waiting for a rabbit.
His friend looked at him and said nothing at all.

title: 3. 一天一天
english_summary: Days turn into weeks. The farmer keeps his seat by the tree while people begin to talk about him — and behind his back, the field is quietly going bad.
content:
一天过去了，两天过去了。
一个星期过去了。
农民每天早上都到树那里去。
他不做别的事情，只是坐着等。
路上的人开始说他。
有的人说，他每天都坐在那里。
有的人问，他不工作了吗？
农民听见了，但是他不想动。
农民：你们不懂。
农民：兔子会来的。
在他后面，田里已经坏了。
但是农民没有回去看。
english_content:
One day went by, then two.
A week went by.
Every morning the farmer went to the tree.
He did nothing else — he only sat and waited.
People on the road began to talk about him.
Some said he sat there every single day.
Some asked whether he had stopped working.
The farmer heard them, but he did not want to move.
Farmer: You don’t understand.
Farmer: The rabbit will come.
Behind him, the field had already gone bad.
But the farmer never went back to look at it.

title: 4. 田怎么了
english_summary: His friend finally walks him back to the field. What was green is not green any more, and the farmer has to look at what his waiting has cost.
content:
这天，那个朋友回来了。
朋友：跟我来一下。
农民：我要等兔子。
朋友：跟我来吧。
他们一起走回田里。
农民看了看，不说话了。
田里没有东西了。
朋友：你在树那里坐了一个月。
朋友：这一个月，你的田没有人去。
农民：但是那只兔子……
朋友：那只兔子是一次，不是每天。
农民坐了下来，很长时间没有起来。
english_content:
That day, the friend came again.
Friend: Come with me for a moment.
Farmer: I have to wait for the rabbit.
Friend: Come with me first.
Together they walked back to the field.
The farmer looked, and stopped talking.
There was nothing left in the field.
Friend: You sat by that tree for a month.
Friend: For a month, nobody looked after your field.
Farmer: But that rabbit…
Friend: That rabbit was once. It was not every day.
The farmer sat down, and for a long time he did not get up.

title: 5. 农民回到田里
english_summary: The farmer goes back to work. The tree is still there, and so is the memory — but now he knows what the rabbit actually was.
content:
第二天早上，农民很早就起床了。
他没有去树那里。
他去了田里。
田里的工作非常多。
他从早上做到晚上，很累。
但是这天晚上，他睡得很好。
过了一些时候，田好起来了。
有一天，他从树旁边走过。
他坐下来，看了看那个树。
农民：我在这里等了一个月。
农民：一只兔子跑错了路，那是一次。
农民：不是每天。
他起来，回田里工作去了。
english_content:
The next morning the farmer got up very early.
He did not go to the tree.
He went to the field.
There was a great deal of work to do there.
He worked from morning to night, and he was tired.
But that night, he slept well.
After a while, the field was good again.
One day he walked past the tree.
He sat down and looked at it.
Farmer: I waited here for a month.
Farmer: One rabbit ran the wrong way. That was once.
Farmer: It was not every day.
He stood up and went back to work in his field.

title: 1. 院子里的大水缸
english_summary: Children play in a courtyard every afternoon. In one corner stands a water jar taller than any of them, and the grown-ups keep telling them to stay away from it.
content:
以前，有几个孩子常常在一个院子里玩。
院子很大，里面有树，也有花。
院子的旁边，有一个大水缸。
水缸比孩子们还高。
水缸里面都是水。
大人常常告诉他们：
妈妈：别到水缸那里去，那里很危险。
孩子们都听见了，但是他们觉得水缸很有意思。
这些孩子里面，有一个叫司马光。
司马光很少说话。
别的孩子跑来跑去的时候，他常常站在旁边看。
小明：司马光，你怎么不过来玩？
司马光：我在想事情。
english_content:
Long ago, several children often played in a courtyard.
The courtyard was large, with trees in it, and flowers too.
Beside the courtyard stood a big water jar.
The jar was taller than the children.
It was full of water.
The grown-ups told them again and again:
Mother: Don’t go near that water jar. It is dangerous.
The children all heard, but they still found the jar interesting.
Among these children was one called Sima Guang.
Sima Guang rarely spoke.
While the others ran about, he often stood to one side and watched.
Xiao Ming: Sima Guang, why don’t you come and play?
Sima Guang: I am thinking about something.

title: 2. 上去看一看
english_summary: On a hot afternoon the children dare each other to climb up and look inside. Xiao Ming goes first, and from up on the rim the water looks a long way down.
content:
那是一个很热的下午。
孩子们玩了很长时间，都很累了。
一个孩子说，水缸里面一定不热。
小明：我们上去看一看，好不好？
别的孩子有点儿怕，但是也有点儿想去。
司马光：大人说过，别到那里去。
小明：只看一下，很快就下来。
小明先爬了上去。
他坐在水缸上面，往下看。
水很黑，他看不到下面。
小明：这里真高啊！
下面的孩子们都笑了。
就在这个时候，小明的手动了一下。
english_content:
It was a very hot afternoon.
The children had played a long time and were tired.
One child said: It must be cool inside that jar.
Xiao Ming: Let’s climb up and take a look, shall we?
The others were a little afraid, and a little tempted too.
Sima Guang: The grown-ups said not to go there.
Xiao Ming: Just one look. I’ll come straight down.
Xiao Ming climbed up first.
He sat on the rim of the jar and looked down.
The water was dark; he could not see the bottom.
Xiao Ming: It really is high up here!
The children below all laughed.
And just then, Xiao Ming’s hand slipped.

title: 3. 水里面
english_summary: Xiao Ming is in the water and cannot get out. The rim is far above his head, the others scatter to find an adult, and the sound from inside the jar keeps getting smaller.
content:
小明进了水里。
水从水缸上面出来了一些。
孩子们都不动了。
过了一会儿，水缸里面有了声音。
小明：救我！
小明想上来，但是他上不来。
他的手拿不住。
水缸的上面离他的头很远。
一个孩子开始哭。
一个孩子叫了起来，来人啊！
几个孩子往院子外面跑，要去找大人。
但是大人在很远的地方。
水缸里面的声音越来越小了。
english_content:
Xiao Ming went into the water.
Water slopped over the top of the jar.
The children all stood frozen.
After a moment, a sound came from inside the jar.
Xiao Ming: Help me!
Xiao Ming tried to get out, but he could not.
His hands could not hold on.
The rim was far above his head.
One child began to cry.
One child shouted: Somebody come!
Several children ran out of the courtyard to fetch a grown-up.
But the grown-ups were far away.
The sound inside the jar was getting smaller and smaller.

title: 4. 司马光没有跑
english_summary: Everyone runs for help. Sima Guang stays where he is and works out that help will come too late — so the problem is not how to get the boy out of the water.
content:
司马光没有跟着他们跑。
他站在那里，看着水缸。
他想，大人不会那么快来。
他又想，小明在水里面，等不了那么久。
大家：司马光，快跑啊！
司马光：跑去找人，太慢了。
孩子：那我们做什么？
司马光：我们上不去，也拿不出来他。
司马光：所以，不能想办法让人出来。
孩子：那……
司马光：要让水出来。
他往院子里面看了一下。
树的旁边，有几块石头。
english_content:
Sima Guang did not run with the others.
He stood where he was, looking at the jar.
He thought: the grown-ups will not come that fast.
And then: Xiao Ming is in the water. He cannot wait that long.
The others called to him: Sima Guang, run!
Sima Guang: Running for help is too slow.
A child: Then what do we do?
Sima Guang: We can’t get up there, and we can’t pull him out.
Sima Guang: So the answer is not getting the person out.
A child: Then…
Sima Guang: We have to get the water out.
He looked around the courtyard.
Beside the tree lay several stones.

title: 5. 水出来了
english_summary: He carries over the biggest stone he can lift. What he does with it is not what anyone else would have thought of, and afterwards a grown-up wants to know who broke the jar.
content:
司马光走过去，拿了一块石头。
石头很大，他两只手拿着。
他慢慢地走回水缸旁边。
别的孩子看着他，谁也不说话。
司马光站好，用力把石头打在水缸上。
第一下，水缸没有坏。
他又打了一下。
水缸破了。
水都出来了。
水和小明一起到了地上。
小明在那里，动了一下。
他还活着。
大人们跑进院子的时候，孩子们正坐在地上。
大人：这个水缸，是谁打破的？
孩子们都看着司马光。
司马光：是我。人比水缸重要。
english_content:
Sima Guang walked over and picked up a stone.
It was big; he held it with both hands.
Slowly he carried it back to the jar.
The other children watched him. Nobody said a word.
He set his feet and struck the jar with the stone as hard as he could.
The first blow did not break it.
He struck again.
The jar broke open.
All the water came out.
The water carried Xiao Ming out onto the ground.
Xiao Ming lay there, and moved.
He was alive.
When the grown-ups came running in, the children were sitting on the ground.
A grown-up: This water jar — who broke it?
All the children looked at Sima Guang.
Sima Guang: I did. A person matters more than a jar.

title: 1. 长得太慢了
english_summary: A farmer plants seedlings and cannot bear how slowly they grow. Every morning he goes to look, and every morning they are the same height as the day before.
content:
以前有一个农民，他在田里种了很多秧苗。
秧苗出来的时候，只有一点点高。
农民每天早上都去田里看它们。
农民：长高一点儿了吗？
但是秧苗一天一天，还是那么高。
农民：为什么这么慢？
旁边的田里，别人的秧苗也是这样。
但是农民不想等。
他晚上睡不着，想着这件事。
农民：一定有办法让它们快一点儿。
english_content:
Long ago there was a farmer who planted many seedlings in his field.
When the seedlings came up, they were only a little bit tall.
Every morning the farmer went to the field to look at them.
Farmer: Have you grown a bit taller?
But day after day the seedlings stayed the same height.
Farmer: Why is it so slow?
In the fields beside his, other people’s seedlings were the same.
But the farmer did not want to wait.
At night he could not sleep, thinking about it.
Farmer: There must be a way to make them faster.

title: 2. 一个办法
english_summary: On a hot afternoon he works out a way to speed things up: if the seedlings need to be taller, he will make them taller himself.
content:
第二天中午，太热了。
农民坐在田旁边，看着他的秧苗。
他想到了一个办法。
农民：秧苗要高，我就把它们往上拉一点儿。
他走进田里，拿着第一个秧苗，往上拉一下。
秧苗真的高了一点儿。
农民很高兴。
他一个一个地拉，从早上到晚上。
english_content:
The next day at noon, it was very hot.
The farmer sat by the field, looking at his seedlings.
Then he thought of a way.
Farmer: If the seedlings need to be tall, I will pull them up a bit.
He walked into the field, took the first seedling, and pulled it up a little.
The seedling really was taller.
The farmer was delighted.
He pulled them one by one, from morning until night.

title: 3. 一天的工作
english_summary: He pulls up every seedling in the field, one by one, from morning until night. He is exhausted, and very pleased with himself.
content:
晚上的时候，他做完了。
农民累得走不动了。
但是他看着田，觉得非常好。
田里的秧苗，都比早上高了。
他慢慢地走回家。
儿子：爸爸，你今天怎么这么累？
农民：我做了一件大事。
农民：我帮田里的秧苗长高了！
english_content:
By evening, he was done.
The farmer was too tired to walk.
But he looked at the field and felt very good.
The seedlings in the field were all taller than they had been that morning.
He walked slowly home.
Son: Dad, why are you so tired today?
Farmer: I did a great thing.
Farmer: I helped the seedlings in the field grow taller!

title: 4. 儿子往田里跑
english_summary: He tells his son about the great thing he did. His son does not say a word — he runs straight out of the door towards the field.
content:
儿子听了，站了起来。
儿子：你做了什么？
农民：我把它们都往上拉一点儿。
儿子没有说话，往门外面跑。
农民：你去哪儿？
儿子跑到田里的时候，已经很晚了。
他看了一下，就不动了。
田里的秧苗，都不好了。
它们的下面已经离开了地。
english_content:
His son listened, and stood up.
Son: You did what?
Farmer: I pulled them all up a little.
His son said nothing and ran out of the door.
Farmer: Where are you going?
By the time his son reached the field, it was already late.
He looked, and then he did not move.
The seedlings in the field were all ruined.
Their roots had already come away from the ground.

title: 5. 第二天早上
english_summary: By morning there is nothing to argue about. The farmer sits by his field and looks at the neighbours’ fields, still growing slowly.
content:
第二天早上，农民也到了田里。
他看着那些秧苗，很久没有说话。
儿子：它们要慢慢地长。
农民：我只是想让它们快一点儿。
儿子：但是你没有让它们快，你让它们没有了。
农民坐在田旁边。
他看了看旁边那些田。
别人的秧苗还在慢慢地长。
english_content:
The next morning, the farmer came to the field too.
He looked at the seedlings and said nothing for a long time.
Son: They have to grow slowly.
Farmer: I only wanted them to be faster.
Son: But you did not make them faster. You made them gone.
The farmer sat down beside the field.
He looked over at the fields beside his own.
Other people’s seedlings were still growing slowly.

title: 1. 田里的田螺
english_summary: A farmer lives alone and comes home to a cold, empty house every night. One afternoon he finds a river snail in his field, bigger than any he has seen, and takes it home.
content:
以前，有一个农民，一个人住。
他每天早上去田里工作，晚上回家。
家里没有别人，也没有人做饭。
他常常很累，回来就睡。
有一天下午，他在田里看见了一个田螺。
这个田螺很大，比他的手还大。
农民：这么大的田螺，我没有见过。
他把田螺拿回了家，让它住在水缸里面。
田螺在水里，没有动。
农民看了它一会儿，就去睡了。
english_content:
Long ago there was a farmer who lived alone.
Every morning he went to the field to work, and came home at night.
There was nobody else at home, and nobody to cook.
He was often tired, and went to sleep as soon as he got back.
One afternoon, he saw a river snail in his field.
This snail was big — bigger than his hand.
Farmer: I have never seen a snail this big.
He took the snail home and let it live in the water jar.
The snail sat in the water and did not move.
The farmer looked at it for a while, then went to sleep.

title: 2. 桌子上的饭
english_summary: The next evening he opens his door and stops. There is rice on the table, and vegetables, and they are still hot. Nobody in the village admits to it.
content:
第二天，农民去田里工作。
晚上回来的时候，天已经很晚了。
他打开门，就不动了。
桌子上有饭，还有菜。
菜是热的。
农民：这是谁做的？
他往外面看，外面没有人。
他问了旁边的人。
朋友：不是我。
朋友：我们今天都在自己家里。
english_content:
The next day, the farmer went to the field to work.
When he came back it was already late.
He opened the door, and stopped.
There was rice on the table, and vegetables.
The food was hot.
Farmer: Who made this?
He looked outside. There was nobody there.
He asked the people next door.
Friend: It wasn’t me.
Friend: We were all in our own homes today.

title: 3. 每天都是这样
english_summary: It happens the next day, and the next. Every evening there is a hot meal waiting, and after many days the farmer decides he has to know who is doing it.
content:
农民回到家，看着桌子上的饭。
他想吃东西，但是他有点儿怕。
最后他还是吃了。
饭非常好吃。
第三天，还是这样。
第四天，第五天，也是这样。
每天晚上回来，桌子上都有热饭热菜。
农民想了很多天。
农民：我一定要知道是谁。
这天早上，他也出了门。
但是他没有去田里。
english_content:
The farmer went back in and looked at the food on the table.
He wanted to eat, but he was a little afraid.
In the end he ate it anyway.
The food was very good.
On the third day, the same thing.
On the fourth day, and the fifth, the same.
Every evening he came home to hot rice and hot vegetables.
The farmer thought about it for many days.
Farmer: I have to know who it is.
That morning, he went out as usual.
But he did not go to the field.

title: 4. 他没有去田里
english_summary: He leaves in the morning as usual, then doubles back and watches his own house from outside the door.
content:
他在外面等了一会儿，就慢慢地走了回来。
他站在门外面，从门口往里面看。
一开始，家里什么声音也没有。
过了一会儿，水缸那里有了声音。
农民往那里看。
水缸里面出来了一个姑娘。
姑娘从水缸里出来，走到桌子旁边。
她开始做饭。
农民在门外面看着，什么也说不出来。
过了很久，他慢慢地打开了门。
english_content:
He waited outside a while, then walked slowly back.
He stood outside the door and looked in.
At first there was no sound in the house at all.
After a while, there was a sound from the water jar.
The farmer looked over.
Out of the water jar came a girl.
She climbed out and walked to the table.
She began to cook.
The farmer watched from outside the door and could not say anything.
After a long time, he slowly opened the door.

title: 5. 你没有吃我
english_summary: What comes out of the water jar is not what he expected, and the answer she gives him is simpler than he thought.
content:
姑娘听见了，回过头来。
她看见农民，站在那里不动了。
农民：是你每天给我做饭吗？
姑娘：是我。
姑娘：你把我从田里拿回来，让我住在水里。
姑娘：你没有吃我。
农民不知道要说什么。
农民：我一个人住了很久。
农民：谢谢你。
姑娘笑了。
那天晚上，他们一起吃了饭。
english_content:
The girl heard him and turned around.
She saw the farmer, and stood quite still.
Farmer: Are you the one who cooks for me every day?
Girl: Yes.
Girl: You brought me back from the field and let me live in the water.
Girl: You did not eat me.
The farmer did not know what to say.
Farmer: I have lived alone a long time.
Farmer: Thank you.
The girl smiled.
That night, they ate together.

title: 1. 书里的照片
english_summary: At a second-hand book stall, Li Ming finds an old photograph tucked inside a thick book. It shows their own street — but with a small shop that no longer exists.
content:
李明：妈妈，我出去一会儿。
妈妈：早点回来，别忘了。
星期六早上，马路上人很多。
李明和小明走到马路的那一头。
那里有一个人在卖旧书。
小明：这些书太旧了。
李明：旧的才有意思。
李明拿起一本很厚的书。
书里面掉出来一张照片。
照片上是一条马路。
马路上有很多人。
中间有一个小小的商店。
小明：这是我们这条马路吗？
李明：好像是，可是不太一样。
照片上没有那个高楼。
李明：这个商店在哪里？
小明：我从来没有见过。
卖书的人笑了。
他说这本书放在这里很久了。
李明把照片放在口袋里。
大毛从旁边走过去。
李明：明天我们再来看看。
小明：看什么？
李明：看看这个地方现在是什么。
english_content:
Li Ming: Mum, I'm going out for a bit.
Mum: Come back early, don't forget.
Saturday morning, the road was full of people.
Li Ming and Xiao Ming walked to the far end of the road.
There was someone there selling old books.
Xiao Ming: These books are too old.
Li Ming: Old ones are the interesting ones.
Li Ming picked up a very thick book.
A photograph fell out of the book.
In the photograph was a road.
There were a lot of people on the road.
In the middle was a small shop.
Xiao Ming: Is this our road?
Li Ming: It looks like it, but it isn't quite the same.
The tall building isn't in the photograph.
Li Ming: Where is this shop?
Xiao Ming: I've never seen it.
The man selling the books laughed.
He said the book had been sitting there a long time.
Li Ming put the photograph in his pocket.
Da Mao walked past beside them.
Li Ming: Let's come back tomorrow and look.
Xiao Ming: Look at what?
Li Ming: At what that place is now.

title: 2. 妈妈也不知道
english_summary: Li Ming shows the photo to his mother. She knows the road at once — she grew up on it — but the shop in the middle means nothing to her. She sends him to the one person who has lived there longest.
content:
晚上，李明把照片拿给妈妈看。
妈妈：这张照片你从哪里拿的？
李明：书里面掉出来的。
妈妈看了很久，没有说话。
妈妈：这条马路我认识。
妈妈：我小的时候就住在这里。
李明：那这个商店呢？
妈妈把照片拿近了一点。
妈妈：这个地方……我不记得了。
李明：你以前天天走这条路。
妈妈：是啊，可是变化太大了。
妈妈：以前这里没有高楼。
妈妈：那时候路也没有这么宽。
李明：那谁会记得？
妈妈想了想。
妈妈：奶奶在这里住了六十年。
妈妈：她什么都记得。
李明：明天我去问她。
妈妈：先吃饭。
李明快快地吃完了饭。
他把照片放在桌子上，看了又看。
照片上的人在笑。
他们好像知道一些事情。
李明：你们是谁呢？
english_content:
In the evening, Li Ming took the photograph to his mother.
Mum: Where did you get this photograph?
Li Ming: It fell out of a book.
Mum looked at it for a long time without speaking.
Mum: I know this road.
Mum: I lived here when I was small.
Li Ming: Then what about this shop?
Mum held the photograph a little closer.
Mum: This place… I don't remember it.
Li Ming: You walked this road every day.
Mum: I did, but it has changed so much.
Mum: There were no tall buildings here before.
Mum: The road wasn't this wide back then either.
Li Ming: Then who would remember?
Mum thought for a moment.
Mum: Grandma has lived here for sixty years.
Mum: She remembers everything.
Li Ming: I'll go and ask her tomorrow.
Mum: Eat first.
Li Ming finished his dinner quickly.
He put the photograph on the table and looked at it again and again.
The people in the photograph were smiling.
They looked like they knew something.
Li Ming: Who are you?

title: 3. 奶奶记得
english_summary: Grandma recognises the shop immediately: a noodle place, run by a man everyone simply called Old Wang. She remembers the smell of it. Then she says the building came, and the shop went — and she doesn't know where the family ended up.
content:
奶奶家在楼上，很安静。
李明和小红一起去的。
小红：奶奶好。
奶奶：来来来，坐。
李明把照片放在桌子上。
奶奶一看就笑了。
奶奶：这是老王的面店。
李明：面店？
奶奶：对，卖面的。
奶奶：那时候我天天去。
小红：好吃吗？
奶奶：非常好吃。
奶奶：一进门就能闻到那个味道。
奶奶：他一个人做，做得很慢。
奶奶：可是大家都愿意等。
李明：后来呢？
奶奶不说话了。
奶奶：后来要盖高楼。
奶奶：这条马路上的小店都关了。
小红：老王去哪里了？
奶奶：不知道。
奶奶：我也很久没有见过他了。
奶奶把照片还给李明。
奶奶：那个味道，我到现在还记得。
english_content:
Grandma's home is upstairs, and very quiet.
Li Ming went with Xiao Hong.
Xiao Hong: Hello, Grandma.
Grandma: Come in, come in, sit down.
Li Ming put the photograph on the table.
Grandma smiled the moment she saw it.
Grandma: That's Old Wang's noodle shop.
Li Ming: A noodle shop?
Grandma: Yes, he sold noodles.
Grandma: I went there every day back then.
Xiao Hong: Was it good?
Grandma: Extremely good.
Grandma: You could smell it the moment you walked in.
Grandma: He made it all himself, and slowly.
Grandma: But everybody was willing to wait.
Li Ming: And afterwards?
Grandma stopped talking.
Grandma: Afterwards they were going to build the tall building.
Grandma: All the little shops on this road closed.
Xiao Hong: Where did Old Wang go?
Grandma: I don't know.
Grandma: I haven't seen him in a very long time either.
Grandma handed the photograph back to Li Ming.
Grandma: That smell — I still remember it even now.

title: 4. 高楼下面
english_summary: They stand where the shop used to be. It is the entrance of the tall building now — glass, and people in a hurry. Then Xiao Hong notices something small on the corner, and the same character on its sign.
content:
他们三个人一起去了那个地方。
李明拿着照片。
小明：应该就是这里。
他们站在高楼下面。
这里没有面店。
只有一个又大又亮的门。
很多人快快地走进走出。
没有人看他们。
小明：什么都没有了。
李明看看照片，又看看前面。
李明：真的是这里。
小红一直没有说话。
她走到旁边，往那边看。
小红：你们来一下。
路口有一个很小的地方。
只有几张桌子，几个人坐着。
上面写着一个字，王。
李明：王？
小红：跟照片上的一样。
李明拿出照片，两个字放在一起看。
真的一样。
小明：可是这个人不是老王。
里面是一个年轻的姑娘。
小红：那我们进去问一问。
english_content:
The three of them went to the place together.
Li Ming was holding the photograph.
Xiao Ming: It should be right here.
They stood beneath the tall building.
There was no noodle shop here.
Only a big, bright doorway.
A lot of people walked quickly in and out.
Nobody looked at them.
Xiao Ming: There's nothing left.
Li Ming looked at the photograph, then ahead again.
Li Ming: It really is here.
Xiao Hong hadn't said anything the whole time.
She walked to one side and looked over that way.
Xiao Hong: Come here a second.
There was a very small place at the corner.
Just a few tables, a few people sitting.
One character was written above it: Wang.
Li Ming: Wang?
Xiao Hong: The same as in the photograph.
Li Ming took the photograph out and held the two characters side by side.
They really were the same.
Xiao Ming: But this person isn't Old Wang.
Inside was a young woman.
Xiao Hong: Then let's go in and ask.

title: 5. 一样的味道
english_summary: The young woman behind the counter takes one look at the photograph and goes quiet. The man in it is her grandfather. She has been making his noodles, in the same way, thirty metres from where he made them.
content:
里面很小，可是很干净。
姑娘：几位？
李明：我们……有一个问题。
他把照片放在桌子上。
姑娘看了一眼，就不动了。
她把手放在照片上面。
姑娘：这是我爷爷。
三个人都没有说话。
姑娘：这张照片你从哪里拿的？
李明：一本旧书里面。
姑娘笑了一下，眼睛有点红。
姑娘：他的店就在那边。
她往高楼那边看了看。
姑娘：后来店没有了，他也老了。
姑娘：他教我做面。
姑娘：他说别的可以变，面不能变。
小红：您现在还是这样做吗？
姑娘：一样的做法。
她走进去，很快就出来了。
三个人面前是三碗面。
李明先吃了一口。
他想起奶奶说的那个味道。
李明：奶奶应该来。
姑娘：让她来。我天天在这里。
english_content:
Inside it was small, but very clean.
Young woman: How many of you?
Li Ming: We… have a question.
He put the photograph on the table.
The young woman glanced at it and went still.
She laid her hand on top of the photograph.
Young woman: This is my grandfather.
None of the three of them said anything.
Young woman: Where did you get this photograph?
Li Ming: Inside an old book.
The young woman smiled a little; her eyes were slightly red.
Young woman: His shop was right over there.
She looked towards the tall building.
Young woman: Later the shop was gone, and he got old.
Young woman: He taught me to make noodles.
Young woman: He said other things can change, noodles can't.
Xiao Hong: Do you still make them the same way now?
Young woman: The same way.
She went inside and came back out very quickly.
In front of the three of them were three bowls of noodles.
Li Ming took the first mouthful.
He thought of the smell Grandma had described.
Li Ming: Grandma should come.
Young woman: Bring her. I'm here every day.

title: 1. 名字在上面
english_summary: The sports day list goes up and Xiao Ming's name is on it — the eight hundred metres, the one race nobody wants. He signed up for nothing. Li Ming works out who did.
content:
学校的门旁边放着一张纸。
很多学生站在前面看。
小红：运动会的名字出来了。
小明也走过去看。
他看了一会儿，不说话了。
李明：怎么了？
小明：上面有我的名字。
李明：哪个？
小明：八百米。
小红笑了出来。
小红：八百米？你？
小明：我没有写过我的名字。
李明：那是谁写的？
三个人一起看那张纸。
小明的名字在中间。
字写得很快，不太好看。
小红：这个字……我认识。
李明：你认识？
小红：像我们老师写的。
小明：为什么是我？
小红：因为别人都不想跑。
小明：我也不想跑。
李明：可是你的名字已经在上面了。
小明看着那张纸，很久没有说话。
小明：还有几天？
李明：五天。
小明：五天……
小红：那从明天开始练习吧。
小明：我为什么要练习？
小红：因为你不想在最后面。
小明听了，没有说话。
他回家的时候走得很慢。
english_content:
There was a sheet of paper up beside the school gate.
A lot of students were standing in front of it, reading.
Xiao Hong: The sports day names are out.
Xiao Ming went over to look too.
He read for a moment, then stopped talking.
Li Ming: What's wrong?
Xiao Ming: My name's on it.
Li Ming: Which one?
Xiao Ming: The eight hundred metres.
Xiao Hong burst out laughing.
Xiao Hong: The eight hundred? You?
Xiao Ming: I never wrote my name down.
Li Ming: Then who wrote it?
The three of them looked at the paper together.
Xiao Ming's name was in the middle.
The writing was fast and not very neat.
Xiao Hong: This handwriting… I know it.
Li Ming: You know it?
Xiao Hong: It looks like our teacher's.
Xiao Ming: Why me?
Xiao Hong: Because nobody else wants to run it.
Xiao Ming: I don't want to run it either.
Li Ming: But your name is already up there.
Xiao Ming looked at the paper and said nothing for a long time.
Xiao Ming: How many days are there?
Li Ming: Five.
Xiao Ming: Five days…
Xiao Hong: Then let's start practising tomorrow.
Xiao Ming: Why should I practise?
Xiao Hong: Because you don't want to come last.
Xiao Ming heard that and said nothing.
He walked home very slowly.

title: 2. 第一天
english_summary: The first training session goes badly. Xiao Ming stops twice, sits down on the ground and says he's finished. Li Ming doesn't argue with him — he just starts running, and keeps running.
content:
第二天下午，他们三个去了学校后面。
那里有一条路，长长的。
小红：跑两圈。
小明：两圈？
小红：对，先试试。
小明开始跑了。
他跑得很快。
李明：慢一点。
小明没有听。
跑到一半的时候，他停下来了。
他站在那里，一直在喘。
小红：你跑得太快了。
小明：我不行。
他坐在了地上。
小明：我做不了这个事情。
小红：你才跑了一点点。
小明：我知道。
李明没有说话。
他站起来，开始跑。
他跑得很慢，可是没有停。
一圈，两圈，三圈。
小明看着他。
小红也看着。
李明跑完了，走过来，脸很红。
李明：慢的可以跑很久。
小明：你为什么跑？
李明：因为你要跑。
小明看着地上，很久。
然后他站了起来。
小明：再来一次。
这次他跑得很慢。
他跑完了两圈。
小红：好。明天见。
english_content:
The next afternoon the three of them went behind the school.
There's a path there, a long one.
Xiao Hong: Two laps.
Xiao Ming: Two?
Xiao Hong: Yes, just try it first.
Xiao Ming started running.
He ran fast.
Li Ming: Slow down.
Xiao Ming didn't listen.
Halfway round, he stopped.
He stood there, breathing hard.
Xiao Hong: You went out too fast.
Xiao Ming: I can't do it.
He sat down on the ground.
Xiao Ming: I can't do this.
Xiao Hong: You've only run a tiny bit.
Xiao Ming: I know.
Li Ming didn't say anything.
He stood up and started running.
He ran very slowly, but he didn't stop.
One lap, two laps, three laps.
Xiao Ming watched him.
Xiao Hong watched too.
Li Ming finished, walked over, his face red.
Li Ming: Slow can go a long way.
Xiao Ming: Why did you run?
Li Ming: Because you have to run.
Xiao Ming looked at the ground for a long time.
Then he stood up.
Xiao Ming: Again.
This time he ran slowly.
He finished the two laps.
Xiao Hong: Good. See you tomorrow.

title: 3. 每天一点
english_summary: Three days of quiet work. Xiao Ming's mother notices he is eating differently and going to bed early. Xiao Hong keeps the times in a notebook and won't show him until the last day.
content:
第三天，小明跑了三圈。
第四天，四圈。
他跑得还是很慢。
可是他没有停下来。
小红拿着一个小本子。
每天她都写一些字在上面。
小明：你写什么？
小红：时间。
小明：给我看看。
小红：不行。
小明：为什么？
小红：最后一天给你看。
小明想了想，没有再问。
晚上，小明回到家。
他吃了很多饭。
他妈妈看着他。
他妈妈看着他，问他今天怎么了。
小明：没什么。
他妈妈说，他以前不这样吃饭。
小明：我最近有点累。
他很早就去睡觉了。
以前他每天晚上都很晚睡。
第五天早上，他自己去了学校后面。
李明和小红还没有来。
他一个人跑了两圈。
然后他们来了。
小红：你来这么早？
小明：我想再跑一次。
李明笑了。
小红也笑了，可是她没有说什么。
她在本子上又写了一行。
那天下午，天气有点儿变了。
风大了起来。
english_content:
On the third day Xiao Ming ran three laps.
On the fourth day, four.
He still ran very slowly.
But he didn't stop.
Xiao Hong carried a little notebook.
Every day she wrote something in it.
Xiao Ming: What are you writing?
Xiao Hong: Times.
Xiao Ming: Let me see.
Xiao Hong: No.
Xiao Ming: Why not?
Xiao Hong: I'll show you on the last day.
Xiao Ming thought about it and didn't ask again.
In the evening Xiao Ming got home.
He ate a lot of dinner.
His mother watched him.
His mother watched him and asked what had got into him today.
Xiao Ming: Nothing.
His mother said he never used to eat like this.
Xiao Ming: I've been a bit tired lately.
He went to bed very early.
He used to stay up late every night.
On the morning of the fifth day he went behind the school on his own.
Li Ming and Xiao Hong hadn't arrived yet.
He ran two laps by himself.
Then they came.
Xiao Hong: You're here this early?
Xiao Ming: I wanted one more run.
Li Ming laughed.
Xiao Hong laughed too, but she didn't say anything.
She wrote another line in the notebook.
That afternoon the weather changed a little.
The wind picked up.

title: 4. 运动会那天
english_summary: Race day. Xiao Ming is not fast and he knows it. Halfway round, a much smaller boy in front of him goes down hard — and Xiao Ming has to decide, in about one second, what the race is for.
content:
运动会那天，天气很好。
学校后面有很多人。
小明站在那里，手是冷的。
李明：紧张吗？
小明：有一点。
小红把本子给他。
小红：现在你可以看了。
小明打开本子。
上面写着五天的时间。
第一天最慢，最后一天最快。
小明看了很久。
小明：真的？
小红：我没有写错。
小明：我快了这么多？
小红：你自己跑的。
比赛开始了。
前面的人跑得很快。
小明没有跟他们跑。
他跑得很慢，跟他练习的时候一样。
第一圈以后，他在中间。
他前面有一个很小的男孩子。
那个男孩子跑得不错。
可是跑到一半，他摔倒了。
他摔在小明前面。
后面的人从旁边跑了过去。
没有人停。
小明也可以跑过去。
他停了下来。
小明：你怎么样？
那个男孩子没有说话，脸上都是土。
小明把他拉了起来。
他们两个一起走到了最后。
小明是最后一个。
可是很多人在看着他们。
english_content:
The weather was good on sports day.
There were a lot of people behind the school.
Xiao Ming stood there with cold hands.
Li Ming: Nervous?
Xiao Ming: A bit.
Xiao Hong handed him the notebook.
Xiao Hong: You can look now.
Xiao Ming opened it.
Five days of times were written in it.
The first day was the slowest, the last day the fastest.
Xiao Ming looked at it for a long time.
Xiao Ming: Really?
Xiao Hong: I didn't write it down wrong.
Xiao Ming: I got that much faster?
Xiao Hong: You ran it yourself.
The race started.
The ones at the front ran fast.
Xiao Ming didn't go with them.
He ran slowly, the same as in training.
After the first lap he was in the middle.
Ahead of him was a much smaller boy.
The boy was running well.
But halfway round, he fell.
He went down right in front of Xiao Ming.
The runners behind went past on either side.
Nobody stopped.
Xiao Ming could have run past too.
He stopped.
Xiao Ming: Are you all right?
The boy didn't speak; his face was covered in dirt.
Xiao Ming pulled him up.
The two of them walked to the finish together.
Xiao Ming came last.
But a lot of people were watching them.

title: 5. 最后一个
english_summary: Afterwards, nobody talks about who won. The small boy's mother finds Xiao Ming to say thank you, the teacher says one short thing, and Xiao Hong finally admits whose handwriting was on that list.
content:
比赛完了以后，大家坐在旁边休息。
小明喝了很多水。
李明：你是最后一个。
小明：我知道。
李明：可是你不难过？
小明想了一下。
小明：不太难过。
小红：为什么？
小明：因为我跑完了。
那个小男孩子和他妈妈走了过来。
孩子：谢谢你。
小明：没关系。
孩子：别的人都跑过去了。
小明：我也差一点跑过去。
他妈妈在旁边笑了。
孩子：可是你没有。
他们走了以后，老师来了。
老师站在小明前面。
老师：今天跑得怎么样？
小明：老师，我是最后一个。
老师：我看见了。
老师：你觉得这个比赛是什么？
小明没有回答。
老师：想一想。
老师走了。
三个人坐在那里，太阳很好。
小红突然说话了。
小红：那个名字，是我写的。
小明：什么？
小红：你的名字。是我写上去的。
小明看着她。
小红：因为你什么都不试。
小明：……
小明：那下次你先问我。
小红：好。
李明在旁边笑了很久。
english_content:
After the race everyone sat at the side and rested.
Xiao Ming drank a lot of water.
Li Ming: You came last.
Xiao Ming: I know.
Li Ming: But you're not upset?
Xiao Ming thought for a second.
Xiao Ming: Not really.
Xiao Hong: Why not?
Xiao Ming: Because I finished.
The small boy and his mother came over.
Boy: Thank you.
Xiao Ming: It's nothing.
Boy: Everyone else ran past.
Xiao Ming: I nearly ran past too.
His mother laughed beside him.
Boy: But you didn't.
After they left, the teacher came.
The teacher stood in front of Xiao Ming.
Teacher: How was the run today?
Xiao Ming: Teacher, I came last.
Teacher: I saw.
Teacher: What do you think this race is for?
Xiao Ming didn't answer.
Teacher: Have a think about it.
The teacher left.
The three of them sat there in the good sunshine.
Xiao Hong suddenly spoke.
Xiao Hong: That name — I wrote it.
Xiao Ming: What?
Xiao Hong: Your name. I put it up there.
Xiao Ming looked at her.
Xiao Hong: Because you never try anything.
Xiao Ming: …
Xiao Ming: Next time ask me first.
Xiao Hong: All right.
Li Ming laughed for a long time beside them.

title: 1. 三天的雨
english_summary: It rains for three days without stopping. Everyone complains about wet shoes and cancelled plans — until Li Ming walks past the corner stall on the third evening and sees water where the floor should be.
content:
星期一开始下雨。
星期二还在下。
星期三，雨更大了。
学校里的人都在说这个雨。
小明：我的鞋子三天都是湿的。
小红：我妈妈说这几十年都没有过。
李明：河里的水也高了很多。
老师：这几天大家早点回家。
下午四点，天已经很暗了。
李明一个人走回家。
他从那个路口过。
姑娘的面店就在那里。
他往里面看了一眼，然后停下来了。
里面的地上有水。
水不深，可是在慢慢地进来。
姑娘一个人站在里面。
她把桌子上的东西往高的地方放。
李明：姐姐，这里进水了！
姑娘：我知道。
李明：要不要我帮你？
姑娘：外面雨太大，你先回家。
李明没有走。
他把书包放在门旁边高的地方。
李明：我可以拿东西。
姑娘看了他一会儿。
姑娘：那你小心一点。
他们两个开始把东西往上面放。
水还在进来。
李明拿出手机。
李明：我给他们打个电话。
小红很快就来了，小明也来了。
三个人的鞋子都湿了。
小红：这些东西放哪里？
姑娘：都放到后面的桌子上。
他们一直做到很晚。
外面的雨没有停。
姑娘：今天先这样。
李明：明天我们再来。
english_content:
It started raining on Monday.
On Tuesday it was still raining.
On Wednesday the rain got heavier.
Everyone at school was talking about the rain.
Xiao Ming: My shoes have been wet for three days.
Xiao Hong: My mum says there hasn't been rain like this in decades.
Li Ming: The water in the river has risen a lot too.
Teacher: Everyone go home early these next few days.
By four in the afternoon it was already very dark.
Li Ming walked home on his own.
He went past that corner.
The young woman's noodle shop is there.
He glanced inside, and then he stopped.
There was water on the floor inside.
It wasn't deep, but it was slowly coming in.
The young woman was standing in there alone.
She was moving the things on the tables up higher.
Li Ming: Excuse me — water's coming in!
Young woman: I know.
Li Ming: Do you want me to help?
Young woman: The rain's too heavy, go home first.
Li Ming didn't go.
He put his school bag somewhere high beside the door.
Li Ming: I can carry things.
The young woman looked at him for a moment.
Young woman: Be careful, then.
The two of them started moving things up.
The water was still coming in.
Li Ming took out his phone.
Li Ming: I'll give them a call.
Xiao Hong came quickly, and Xiao Ming came too.
All three of them had wet shoes.
Xiao Hong: Where do these go?
Young woman: All of it onto the tables at the back.
They kept at it until very late.
The rain outside didn't stop.
Young woman: That's enough for today.
Li Ming: We'll come back tomorrow.

title: 2. 水下面的地
english_summary: Thursday morning: the rain has stopped and the water has gone, leaving a floor nobody can use and a smell nobody can shift. Grandma arrives with the one thing that turns out to matter — she has seen this before.
content:
星期四早上，雨停了。
天还是灰的，可是没有下了。
三个人早早就到了那个路口。
水已经下去了。
可是里面的地上都是土。
姑娘站在门口，很累的样子。
姑娘：你们真的来了。
小红：我们说了会来。
李明：现在做什么？
姑娘：地要洗，可是水太脏。
小明：那个味道……
姑娘：我知道。
那个味道很重，进来就能闻到。
小红：这个洗得掉吗？
姑娘：不知道。
李明想了一下，拿出手机。
李明：我打个电话。
二十分钟以后，奶奶来了。
她走得很慢，手里拿着一个袋子。
奶奶：让我看看。
她走进去，站了一会儿。
她看看地，又看看墙。
奶奶：这个我见过。
姑娘：您见过？
奶奶：六十年前，也是这样的雨。
奶奶：那时候这里也进水。
姑娘看着她，没有说话。
奶奶：你爷爷那时候就在这条路上。
姑娘：您认识我爷爷？
奶奶笑了。
奶奶：我天天在他那里吃面。
屋子里一下子安静了。
李明看看小红，小红看看小明。
奶奶把袋子放在桌子上。
奶奶：先别急着洗。
奶奶：地要等它自己干。
奶奶：干了以后才洗得干净。
姑娘：谢谢您。
奶奶：小事。
english_content:
On Thursday morning the rain stopped.
The sky was still grey, but nothing was falling.
The three of them got to the corner early.
The water had already gone down.
But the floor inside was covered in dirt.
The young woman stood in the doorway, looking exhausted.
Young woman: You actually came.
Xiao Hong: We said we would.
Li Ming: What do we do now?
Young woman: The floor needs washing, but the water's too dirty.
Xiao Ming: That smell…
Young woman: I know.
The smell was strong; you could smell it the moment you walked in.
Xiao Hong: Will it wash out?
Young woman: I don't know.
Li Ming thought for a second and took out his phone.
Li Ming: I'll make a call.
Twenty minutes later, Grandma arrived.
She walked slowly, carrying a bag.
Grandma: Let me have a look.
She went in and stood there a while.
She looked at the floor, then at the wall.
Grandma: I've seen this before.
Young woman: You have?
Grandma: Sixty years ago, rain just like this.
Grandma: The water came in here then too.
The young woman looked at her without speaking.
Grandma: Your grandfather was on this road back then.
Young woman: You knew my grandfather?
Grandma smiled.
Grandma: I ate noodles at his place every day.
The room went quiet all at once.
Li Ming looked at Xiao Hong, and Xiao Hong looked at Xiao Ming.
Grandma put the bag down on the table.
Grandma: Don't rush to wash it.
Grandma: The floor has to dry on its own.
Grandma: It only washes clean once it's dry.
Young woman: Thank you.
Grandma: It's nothing.

title: 3. 关着的门
english_summary: The stall stays shut for four days and the corner feels wrong without it. Then the three of them notice something: they are not the only ones who keep walking past to check.
content:
面店关了四天。
门上贴着一张纸。
上面写着，这几天不开门。
李明每天都从那里走。
每天他都看一眼那个门。
星期五，小红也去看了。
星期六，小明去了两次。
小明：还是关着。
李明：地还没有干。
小红：这几天她怎么办？
没有人知道。
星期日下午，三个人一起去了。
他们站在路口，看着那个关着的门。
然后李明发现了一件事情。
还有别的人也停在那里。
一个老人站了一会儿，然后走了。
一个开车的人开得很慢，往这边看。
两个上班的人站在门口说话。
他们在说，怎么还没开。
小红：这些人都是来吃面的。
小明：这么多人？
李明：一个小店，这么多人记得。
他们站在那里，看了很久。
后来姑娘从后面走出来了。
她手里拿着一块布。
姑娘：你们又来了。
李明：里面怎么样了？
姑娘：地干了。
姑娘：可是东西坏了很多。
小红：那什么时候开门？
姑娘没有马上回答。
姑娘：我在想，还开不开。
三个人都看着她。
姑娘：这个店本来就不大。
姑娘：这次以后，钱也不多了。
李明：可是刚才有很多人来。
姑娘：什么？
小红：真的，我们都看见了。
姑娘看着他们，然后往路口看。
她很久没有说话。
english_content:
The noodle shop stayed shut for four days.
There was a sheet of paper on the door.
It said: closed for a few days.
Li Ming walked past it every day.
Every day he glanced at the door.
On Friday Xiao Hong went to look too.
On Saturday Xiao Ming went twice.
Xiao Ming: Still shut.
Li Ming: The floor isn't dry yet.
Xiao Hong: What is she doing all these days?
Nobody knew.
On Sunday afternoon the three of them went together.
They stood at the corner looking at the closed door.
Then Li Ming noticed something.
Other people were stopping there too.
An old man stood for a moment, then walked on.
Someone driving slowed right down and looked over.
Two people on their way to work stood at the door talking.
They were saying: why isn't it open yet?
Xiao Hong: All these people came to eat noodles.
Xiao Ming: This many?
Li Ming: One little shop, and this many people remember it.
They stood there watching for a long time.
Later the young woman came out from the back.
She had a cloth in her hand.
Young woman: You're here again.
Li Ming: How is it inside?
Young woman: The floor's dry.
Young woman: But a lot of things are ruined.
Xiao Hong: So when are you opening?
She didn't answer straight away.
Young woman: I'm wondering whether to open at all.
All three of them looked at her.
Young woman: The shop was never big.
Young woman: After this, there isn't much money either.
Li Ming: But a lot of people came just now.
Young woman: What?
Xiao Hong: Really, we all saw them.
She looked at them, then out towards the corner.
She said nothing for a long time.

title: 4. 一张纸
english_summary: Xiao Hong has an idea that costs nothing: a sheet of paper on the door asking one question. By Tuesday evening there is no room left on it, and the answers are not what anyone expected.
content:
那天晚上，小红想到了一个办法。
小红：我们贴一张纸。
李明：写什么？
小红：问大家一个问题。
小明：什么问题？
小红：问他们记不记得这里的面。
李明：然后呢？
小红：让他们自己写。
第二天早上，他们拿了一张很大的纸。
小红在上面写了一行字。
小红写的是，你还记得这里的面吗？
姑娘看着他们贴。
姑娘：不会有人写的。
小红：那就不会有人写。
她们把纸贴在门旁边。
旁边放了一支笔。
那天下午，纸上有三行字。
晚上，有七行。
星期二早上，纸上写满了。
姑娘站在门口看那张纸。
上面有很多不一样的字。
有的写得很好看，有的很难看。
有人写，我上班以前天天在这里吃。
有人写，我爸爸带我来过。
有人写，三十年了，还是这个味道。
有人写，我第一次一个人吃饭就在这里。
小明：这个人的字好小。
小红：下面还有。
最下面有一行很小的字。
那一行写的是，老王教我做面，我在南边开了一家。
姑娘看到这一行，站了很久。
姑娘：这个人……
李明：您认识？
姑娘：我不认识。
姑娘：可是我爷爷教过的人，我都想见。
她把那张纸从门上拿了下来。
她拿得很小心。
姑娘：这个我要留着。
小红：那您开门吗？
姑娘笑了一下。
姑娘：明天早上六点。
english_content:
That evening Xiao Hong thought of something.
Xiao Hong: Let's put a sheet of paper up.
Li Ming: Saying what?
Xiao Hong: Asking everyone one question.
Xiao Ming: What question?
Xiao Hong: Ask them if they remember the noodles here.
Li Ming: And then?
Xiao Hong: Let them write it themselves.
The next morning they got a big sheet of paper.
Xiao Hong wrote one line on it.
It said: do you still remember the noodles here?
The young woman watched them put it up.
Young woman: Nobody's going to write on it.
Xiao Hong: Then nobody writes on it.
They stuck the paper up beside the door.
They left a pen next to it.
That afternoon there were three lines on it.
By evening there were seven.
On Tuesday morning the paper was full.
The young woman stood in the doorway looking at it.
There was a lot of different handwriting on it.
Some of it was neat, some of it was terrible.
One person wrote: I ate here every day before work.
One person wrote: my dad brought me here.
One person wrote: thirty years, and it still tastes the same.
One person wrote: the first meal I ever ate alone was here.
Xiao Ming: This person's writing is tiny.
Xiao Hong: There's more underneath.
Right at the bottom was a line in very small writing.
It said: Old Wang taught me to make noodles; I opened a place in the south.
The young woman saw that line and stood there a long while.
Young woman: This person…
Li Ming: Do you know them?
Young woman: I don't.
Young woman: But anyone my grandfather taught, I want to meet.
She took the paper down off the door.
She took it down very carefully.
Young woman: I'm keeping this.
Xiao Hong: So you're opening?
She gave a small smile.
Young woman: Six o'clock tomorrow morning.

title: 5. 早上六点
english_summary: Six in the morning, and the three of them are the only ones there — for about four minutes. Grandma comes, and then everyone else, and the paper goes back up on the wall inside where the photograph now hangs beside it.
content:
早上五点五十，天还没有全亮。
三个人站在路口。
小明：我从来没有这么早起来过。
小红：你现在还想睡？
小明：想。
李明：门开了。
里面亮着灯。
姑娘打开门，看见他们，笑了。
姑娘：你们三个。
李明：我们要吃第一碗。
他们坐了下来。
里面很干净，跟以前不一样。
地是新洗的，桌子也是。
墙上有两个东西。
一个是那张写满字的纸。
一个是李明的那张老照片。
李明看到自己的照片在墙上，一下子没有说话。
李明：您把它放上去了？
姑娘：这本来就是这里的东西。
面很快就来了。
三碗，热的。
六点零四分，门又开了。
奶奶走了进来。
奶奶：我说我要来的。
姑娘：您坐这里。
六点十分，两个上班的人进来了。
六点二十，那个老人也来了。
六点半，桌子都坐满了。
有人站着等。
没有人急。
小红小声说，跟照片上一样。
李明看看墙上的照片，又看看屋子里。
照片上的人在笑，屋子里的人也在笑。
中间那个小小的店，现在在这里。
姑娘一个人在后面做面，做得很慢。
可是没有人说什么。
大家都在等。
李明吃完了，把碗放下。
他觉得这一天开始得很好。
english_content:
At ten to six the sky wasn't fully light yet.
The three of them stood at the corner.
Xiao Ming: I have never got up this early in my life.
Xiao Hong: Do you still want to be asleep?
Xiao Ming: Yes.
Li Ming: The door's open.
The light was on inside.
The young woman opened the door, saw them, and smiled.
Young woman: You three.
Li Ming: We want the first bowl.
They sat down.
Inside was very clean, different from before.
The floor had just been washed, and so had the tables.
There were two things on the wall.
One was the sheet of paper covered in writing.
The other was Li Ming's old photograph.
Li Ming saw his photograph up on the wall and for a second said nothing.
Li Ming: You put it up?
Young woman: It belonged here in the first place.
The noodles came quickly.
Three bowls, hot.
At four minutes past six the door opened again.
Grandma came in.
Grandma: I said I'd come.
Young woman: Sit here.
At ten past six, two people on their way to work came in.
At twenty past, the old man came too.
By half past six every table was full.
Some people stood and waited.
Nobody was in a hurry.
Xiao Hong said quietly: it's like the photograph.
Li Ming looked at the photograph on the wall, then round the room.
The people in the photograph were smiling, and so were the people in the room.
That little shop in the middle is here now.
The young woman made the noodles alone at the back, slowly.
But nobody said anything about it.
Everyone waited.
Li Ming finished and set his bowl down.
He thought the day had started well.

title: 1. 妈妈的电话
english_summary: A phone call after dinner that his mother takes out on the balcony, and doesn't explain. Li Ming notices she says almost nothing, and that she says it very carefully.
content:
吃完饭以后，妈妈的手机响了。
她看了一眼，走到外面去接。
李明在里面写作业。
他听不清楚外面说什么。
可是他听得出来，妈妈说得很慢。
她平时打电话不是这样的。
过了十几分钟，她还没有进来。
李明放下笔，往外面看了看。
妈妈站在那里，一只手拿着手机。
另一只手放在旁边的墙上。
她没有在笑，也没有不高兴。
她只是在听。
最后她说了一句：我想一想。
然后她进来了，把手机放在桌子上。
李明：谁的电话？
妈妈：公司的。
李明：这么晚还给你打电话？
妈妈：有点事情。
李明：什么事情？
妈妈看了他一眼。
妈妈：还没有定，定了再说。
她说完就去洗碗了。
李明听着厨房里的声音。
那天晚上，那个声音比平时长。
english_content:
After dinner, Mum's phone rang.
She glanced at it and went outside to take it.
Li Ming was doing his homework inside.
He couldn't hear clearly what was being said outside.
But he could tell she was speaking slowly.
She doesn't usually make calls like that.
Ten-odd minutes went by and she still hadn't come back in.
Li Ming put down his pen and looked outside.
Mum was standing there with the phone in one hand.
Her other hand rested on the wall beside her.
She wasn't smiling, and she wasn't unhappy.
She was just listening.
At the end she said one thing: let me think about it.
Then she came in and put the phone on the table.
Li Ming: Who was that?
Mum: Work.
Li Ming: They call you this late?
Mum: Something came up.
Li Ming: What sort of something?
Mum glanced at him.
Mum: Nothing's decided. I'll tell you when it is.
And with that she went to wash up.
Li Ming listened to the sounds from the kitchen.
That night they went on longer than usual.

title: 2. 另外一个城市
english_summary: She tells them on Saturday, at the table, in one sentence — a better job, in a city four hours away. Then she asks a question that Li Ming realises she has already been asking herself all week.
content:
星期六早上，妈妈让大家坐下。
妈妈：我有件事要跟你们说。
爸爸已经知道了，他没有说话。
妈妈：公司想让我去另外一个城市工作。
李明：多远？
妈妈：坐火车四个小时。
李明：多久？
妈妈：他们说，至少两年。
屋子里安静了一会儿。
李明：那我们呢？
妈妈：这就是我要问你们的。
爸爸：这个机会不容易得到。
妈妈：我知道。
李明：你想去吗？
妈妈没有马上回答。
妈妈：我在这个公司做了十四年。
妈妈：这是第一次有人问我这个。
李明：这不是回答。
妈妈笑了一下。
妈妈：我想去。
她说完，看着桌子。
妈妈：可是想去和应该去，不一样。
李明：为什么不一样？
妈妈：因为家在这里。
那天没有人再说这件事情。
可是晚上李明看见客厅的灯很晚才关。
english_content:
On Saturday morning Mum asked everyone to sit down.
Mum: There's something I need to tell you.
Dad already knew; he didn't say anything.
Mum: The company wants me to work in another city.
Li Ming: How far?
Mum: Four hours by train.
Li Ming: For how long?
Mum: They say at least two years.
The room was quiet for a moment.
Li Ming: What about us?
Mum: That's exactly what I want to ask you.
Dad: An opportunity like this doesn't come easily.
Mum: I know.
Li Ming: Do you want to go?
Mum didn't answer straight away.
Mum: I've been at that company fourteen years.
Mum: This is the first time anyone has asked me that.
Li Ming: That's not an answer.
Mum smiled slightly.
Mum: I want to go.
Having said it, she looked at the table.
Mum: But wanting to go and ought to go aren't the same.
Li Ming: Why aren't they the same?
Mum: Because home is here.
Nobody mentioned it again that day.
But that evening Li Ming saw the living-room light stay on very late.

title: 3. 别人的意见
english_summary: Everyone has an opinion and none of them are about his mother. Xiao Hong says something at lunch that Li Ming doesn't like, mostly because it is true.
content:
星期一，李明跟朋友说了这件事情。
小明：四个小时？那不算远。
小红：两年不算短。
小明：你妈妈自己想去吗？
李明：她说她想。
小明：那就让她去啊。
李明：说得容易。
小红一直没有说话。
她把饭吃完了才开口。
小红：你为什么不高兴？
李明：我没有不高兴。
小红：你从早上就是这个样子。
李明：……
小红：你是怕她走，还是怕自己不方便？
李明看着她，没有回答。
小红：对不起，我说得太直接了。
李明：不，你说得对。
他把手里的筷子放下了。
李明：昨天我想的都是我自己。
李明：谁做饭，谁接我，星期天怎么办。
李明：我一次也没有想过她想要什么。
小红：现在想也来得及。
小明：你可以问她啊。
李明：问什么？
小红：问她这十四年，有没有等过这样一个机会。
english_content:
On Monday Li Ming told his friends about it.
Xiao Ming: Four hours? That's not far.
Xiao Hong: Two years isn't short.
Xiao Ming: Does your mum want to go herself?
Li Ming: She says she does.
Xiao Ming: Then let her go.
Li Ming: Easy for you to say.
Xiao Hong hadn't said anything the whole time.
She finished her food before she spoke.
Xiao Hong: Why are you upset?
Li Ming: I'm not upset.
Xiao Hong: You've been like this since this morning.
Li Ming: …
Xiao Hong: Are you afraid she'll leave, or afraid it'll be inconvenient for you?
Li Ming looked at her and didn't answer.
Xiao Hong: Sorry, that was too blunt.
Li Ming: No, you're right.
He put down the chopsticks in his hand.
Li Ming: Everything I thought about yesterday was about me.
Li Ming: Who cooks, who picks me up, what happens on Sundays.
Li Ming: I didn't once think about what she wants.
Xiao Hong: There's still time to think about it.
Xiao Ming: You could just ask her.
Li Ming: Ask her what?
Xiao Hong: Ask whether in fourteen years she's been waiting for a chance like this.

title: 4. 奶奶的话
english_summary: Li Ming goes to his grandmother expecting her to take his side. She tells him about a decision she made at almost the same age, and about the part of it she never talks about.
content:
李明去了奶奶家。
奶奶正在看电视，声音开得很大。
李明：奶奶，妈妈要去别的城市工作。
奶奶把电视关了。
奶奶：她跟我说了。
李明：您觉得她应该去吗？
奶奶：你希望我说什么？
李明：说她不应该去。
奶奶笑了。
奶奶：那你找错人了。
她站起来，去倒了两杯水。
奶奶：我三十岁那年，也有过一个机会。
李明：什么机会？
奶奶：南边有个学校要我去教书。
李明：您去了吗？
奶奶：没有。
李明：为什么？
奶奶：因为家里都说不方便。
奶奶：我自己也怕。
李明：后来呢？
奶奶：后来我在这里过了很好的一生。
奶奶：可是每年春天，我都会想起那个学校。
她把水放在李明前面。
奶奶：我不是让你妈妈走。
奶奶：我是不想她六十年以后，还在想这件事。
english_content:
Li Ming went to his grandmother's.
She was watching television with the volume right up.
Li Ming: Grandma, Mum's going to work in another city.
She turned the television off.
Grandma: She told me.
Li Ming: Do you think she should go?
Grandma: What do you want me to say?
Li Ming: That she shouldn't.
Grandma laughed.
Grandma: Then you've come to the wrong person.
She got up and poured two cups of water.
Grandma: The year I turned thirty, I had a chance too.
Li Ming: What chance?
Grandma: A school down south wanted me to go and teach.
Li Ming: Did you go?
Grandma: No.
Li Ming: Why not?
Grandma: Because everyone at home said it was inconvenient.
Grandma: And I was afraid myself.
Li Ming: And afterwards?
Grandma: Afterwards I had a very good life here.
Grandma: But every spring, I still think about that school.
She put the water down in front of Li Ming.
Grandma: I'm not telling your mother to go.
Grandma: I just don't want her thinking about this sixty years from now.

title: 5. 四个小时
english_summary: Li Ming finally asks his mother the right question, and gets an answer neither of them expected to arrive at that evening — along with a very specific plan involving a train timetable.
content:
星期三晚上，李明进了厨房。
妈妈正在洗菜。
李明：妈，我问你一件事。
妈妈：你说。
李明：这十四年，你有没有等过这样的机会？
妈妈的手停了一下。
她把水关上，转过身来。
妈妈：谁教你这么问的？
李明：小红。
妈妈笑了，眼睛有点红。
妈妈：等过。
李明：那你去吧。
妈妈：你想清楚了？
李明：没有。
李明：可是我想清楚了一件事。
李明：我不想成为你不去的原因。
妈妈看了他很久。
妈妈：你什么时候长这么大了。
她拿出手机，打开一个东西给他看。
上面是火车的时间。
妈妈：星期五晚上七点，回来。
妈妈：星期日晚上八点，走。
李明：你已经查好了？
妈妈：查了一个星期了。
李明：那你还问我们做什么？
妈妈：因为我想听你们自己说。
english_content:
On Wednesday evening Li Ming went into the kitchen.
Mum was washing vegetables.
Li Ming: Mum, I want to ask you something.
Mum: Go on.
Li Ming: In these fourteen years, have you been waiting for a chance like this?
Mum's hands stopped for a second.
She turned the water off and turned around.
Mum: Who taught you to ask it like that?
Li Ming: Xiao Hong.
Mum laughed, her eyes a little red.
Mum: I have.
Li Ming: Then go.
Mum: Have you thought it through?
Li Ming: No.
Li Ming: But I have worked out one thing.
Li Ming: I don't want to be the reason you didn't go.
Mum looked at him for a long time.
Mum: When did you get so grown up.
She took out her phone and opened something to show him.
On it were train times.
Mum: Friday, seven in the evening, back.
Mum: Sunday, eight in the evening, away.
Li Ming: You've already looked them up?
Mum: I've been looking them up for a week.
Li Ming: Then why did you even ask us?
Mum: Because I wanted to hear you say it yourselves.
